series.name: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)
series.notes: Smallest UPS in the Eaton line. The manual publishes NO numeric fault codes at all - diagnosis is by numbered LCD icon (6 = ON/OFF button, 8 = ASR LED, 12 = Internal fault, 18 = Surge protection outlets, 19 = Battery backup outlets, 20 = Protection circuit breaker) plus the numbered Problem/Diagnostic/Solution table. The 'Internal fault' LCD icon 12 is the closest thing to a fault code. Do NOT merge with the 5P/5P Gen2 tables: those use different LED names and different wording. This manual is multi-language in one PDF; the entries below come from the ENGLISH section (pages 6-9).

title.ur: Battery mode (button 6 green flash karta hai)

meaning.en: AC power is disturbed or failed, so the UPS runs on battery. Audible alarm beeps every 10 s, then every 3 s near end of runtime.
meaning.ur: AC power disturb ya fail hua hai, is liye UPS battery par chal raha hai. Audible alarm pehle har 10 second, phir runtime khatam hone par har 3 second beepta hai.

causes.en: The mains supply has failed or dipped outside the AVR input window (165-285 V adjustable to 150-285 V).
causes.ur: Mains supply chala gaya hai ya AVR input window (165-285 V, 150-285 V tak adjustable) se bahar gir gaya hai.

causes.en: The mains is present but of poor quality, so the UPS keeps transferring to battery.
causes.ur: Mains maujood hai magar quality kharab hai, is liye UPS baar baar battery par chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Save your work and shut down equipment before the end of backup time; the alarm speeds up to every 3 s as a warning.
solutions.ur: Backup time khatam hone se pehle kaam bacha lein aur equipment band karein; warning ke taur par alarm 3 second par beepta hai.

solutions.en: If the outage lasts longer than the backup time the UPS shuts down by itself; it restarts automatically when power is restored.
solutions.ur: Agar outage backup time se lamba rahe to UPS khud band ho jata hai; power wapas aane par khud restart ho jata hai.

solutions.en: On mains return, confirm the unit back on mains by pressing button 6, and give the battery 8 hours of charge before first use.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par button 6 dabayein taake unit mains par wapas aa jaye, aur pehli istemal se pehle battery ko 8 ghante charge dein.

codes.blinkPattern: ON/OFF button 6 flashes green; 1 beep every 10 seconds then 1 beep every 3 seconds (silent mode: single beep on transfer to battery)

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

title.ur: Problem 1 - battery backup outlets power nahi de rahe

meaning.en: The battery-backed outlets are not being supplied. Diagnostic: the ON/OFF button 6 is not lit.
meaning.ur: Battery backup outlets supply nahi ho rahe. Diagnostic: ON/OFF button 6 jal nahi raha.

causes.en: The battery-backed outlets have simply been switched off at button 6.
causes.ur: Battery backup outlets button 6 se band kar diye gaye hain.

causes.en: The UPS was shut down from the front panel and never restarted.
causes.ur: UPS ko front panel se band kiya gaya aur dobara start nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Press button 6 and check that it turns green - that confirms the battery-backed outlets are switched on.
solutions.ur: Button 6 dabayein aur check karein ke woh green ho jata hai - is ka matlab battery backup outlets on hain.

solutions.en: Read the LCD icons 9 (UPS ON) and 11 (Battery mode) to confirm the UPS itself is running.
solutions.ur: LCD icons 9 (UPS ON) aur 11 (Battery mode) parhein taake confirm ho ke UPS khud chal raha hai.

solutions.en: If button 6 will not light at all, check the rear input protection circuit breaker 20 is in the reset (not pressed-in) position.
solutions.ur: Agar button 6 bilkul na jale to check karein ke peeche wala input protection circuit breaker 20 reset position (dabba hua nahi) mein hai.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

title.en: Problem 2 - devices not on battery outlets
title.ur: Problem 2 - devices battery outlets par nahi lage

meaning.en: Connected devices are not supplied during an AC power failure because they are plugged into surge-only outlets, not battery-backed ones.
meaning.ur: AC power failure par connected devices power nahi lete kyunke woh sirf surge protection wale outlets mein lage hain, battery backup wale mein nahi.

causes.en: The device is plugged into a surge-protection-only outlet (icon 18) instead of a battery backup outlet (icon 19).
causes.ur: Device surge-protection-only outlet (icon 18) mein laga hai, battery backup outlet (icon 19) mein nahi.

causes.en: The device is fed from a different outlet strip that is not backed by the UPS.
causes.ur: Device aisi alag outlet strip se chal raha hai jo UPS se backed nahi hai.

solutions.en: Read the LCD and count which outlets are battery-backed (650/850 have 2 backup + 2 surge-only; 1200/1600 have 4 + 4).
solutions.ur: LCD parhein aur count karein ke kaun se outlets battery-backed hain (650/850 mein 2 backup + 2 sirf surge; 1200/1600 mein 4 + 4).

solutions.en: Move the device's plug into a battery backup outlet (icon 19) using a voltage tester to confirm it is live.
solutions.ur: Device ka plug battery backup outlet (icon 19) mein daalein aur voltage tester se confirm karein ke woh live hai.

solutions.en: Re-test by switching mains off briefly and confirming the device stays up.
solutions.ur: Mains thodi der ke liye band karke dobara test karein aur confirm karein ke device chalta rehta hai.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

title.en: Problem 3 - running on battery though mains is present
title.ur: Problem 3 - mains maujood hai magar battery par chal raha hai

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery even though AC power is available, because the rear protection circuit breaker 20 has tripped on an output overload.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par chal raha hai jabke AC power maujood hai, kyunke peeche wala protection circuit breaker 20 output overload par trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The resettable input protection breaker (20) tripped on an overload.
causes.ur: Resettable input protection breaker (20) overload par trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment is connected to the UPS outlets in total.
causes.ur: UPS outlets par total bohat zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A shorted load or a failed power strip tripped the breaker.
causes.ur: Koi short hua load ya kharab power strip breaker trip kar gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off with button 6 and unplug the mains before touching the rear breaker.
solutions.ur: Button 6 se unit band karein aur peeche wale breaker ko chhoone se pehle mains nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect excess equipment, then reset circuit breaker 20 by pressing the corresponding button back into its normal position.
solutions.ur: Zyada equipment disconnect karein, phir circuit breaker 20 ko us ke button ko daba kar normal position mein reset karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter or check the LCD load level icon 13; keep the load under the model's rated VA/W.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load maarein ya LCD ke load level icon 13 dekhein; load ko model ki rated VA/W ke neeche rakhein.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

meaning.en: The green button 6 flashes and the audible alarm beeps every 3 seconds: the battery backup outlets 19 are overloaded.
meaning.ur: Green button 6 flash karta hai aur audible alarm har 3 second beepta hai: battery backup outlets 19 overloaded hain.

causes.en: The equipment on the battery-backed outlets exceeds their rated current (650/850: 3 A; 850: 3.6 A; 1200: 5.5 A; 1600: 7.3 A per backup bank).
causes.ur: Battery backup outlets par lagi equipment un ki rated current se zyada hai (650/850: 3 A; 850: 3.6 A; 1200: 5.5 A; 1600: 7.3 A per backup bank).

causes.en: A high-starting-current device such as a laser printer was switched on during discharge.
causes.ur: Discharge ke doran koi high starting current wala device jaise laser printer on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect excess equipment connected to the battery backup outlets 19 immediately.
solutions.ur: Battery backup outlets 19 se juri zyada equipment foran disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the current drawn by each connected device with a clamp meter and total it against the outlet rating on the manual's specification table.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har connected device ka current maarein aur manual ki specification table ki outlet rating se jama karein.

solutions.en: Move printers, monitors and other non-critical devices to the surge-only outlets (icon 18).
solutions.ur: Printer, monitor aur doosre ghair zaroori devices sirf surge wale outlets (icon 18) par le jaayein.

codes.blinkPattern: ON/OFF button 6 flashes green, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

title.ur: Fault sign 12 - internal fault (andar ki kharabi)

meaning.en: A fault has occurred inside the UPS. The battery backup outlets 19 are no longer supplied and the audible alarm beeps continuously.
meaning.ur: UPS ke andar fault aa gaya hai. Battery backup outlets 19 ab supply nahi karte aur audible alarm continuous beepta hai.

causes.en: Internal power stage or control failure inside the small UPS.
causes.ur: Chhote UPS ke andar power stage ya control ki kharabi.

causes.en: Output short circuit or a deeply failed battery string dragging the DC rail out of range.
causes.ur: Output short circuit ya bohat kharab battery string DC rail ko range se bahar kheench rahi hai.

solutions.en: Call after-sales support as the manual directs; this is not a user-repairable condition.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq after-sales support ko call karein; ye user ke taur par theek karne wali halat nahi hai.

solutions.en: Record the model number, the LCD readings (icons 13 load level and 14 battery level) and what was running at the time of the fault.
solutions.ur: Model number, LCD readings (icon 13 load level aur 14 battery level) aur fault ke waqt kya chal raha tha, sab likh lein.

solutions.en: Unplug the mains and move your equipment to a protected supply in the meantime; the battery backup outlets are dead on this condition.
solutions.ur: Mains nikaal dein aur apna equipment abhi protected supply par le jaayein; is halat mein battery backup outlets marr chuke hain.

codes.blinkPattern: LCD icon 12 (Internal fault) shown on panel, audible alarm beeps continuously

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

title.en: Problem 6 - surge protection gone (ASR LED off)
title.ur: Problem 6 - surge protection chala gaya (ASR LED off)

meaning.en: The green LED 8 (ASR) is off while the filtered outlets 18 are still supplied, so the surge protection device has died.
meaning.ur: Green LED 8 (ASR) off hai jabke filtered outlets 18 ab bhi supply ho rahe hain, is liye surge protection device mar chuka hai.

causes.en: The MOV surge protection module has failed after absorbing a large surge.
causes.ur: MOV surge protection module ne bada surge absorb karne ke baad kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Repeated smaller surges have degraded the MOVs to the point of failure.
causes.ur: Baar baar chhote surges ne MOVs ko itna degrade kiya ke woh fail ho gaye.

solutions.en: Do not plug any sensitive or expensive equipment into the filtered outlets while LED 8 is off.
solutions.ur: LED 8 off hone par koi mehfoof ya mehnga equipment filtered outlets mein na lagayein.

solutions.en: Call after-sales support as the manual directs; the surge module is not user replaceable.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq after-sales support ko call karein; surge module user ke taur par nahi badla ja sakta.

solutions.en: Inspect the mains earth and check for repeated voltage spikes on the incoming line with a DMM logger.
solutions.ur: Mains earth dekh lein aur DMM logger se incoming line par baar baar voltage spikes check karein.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

title.ur: Problem 7 - EcoControl outlets power par qatam nahi hote

meaning.en: The EcoControl outlets keep supplying power after the main (Master) outlet is switched off, so peripherals are not being cut.
meaning.ur: Main (Master) outlet band hone ke baad bhi EcoControl outlets power dete rahte hain, is liye peripherals band nahi ho rahe.

causes.en: The EcoControl function is deactivated (it is off by default).
causes.ur: EcoControl function deactivated hai (ye default par band hota hai).

causes.en: EcoControl is active but the Master outlet has not been assigned correctly.
causes.ur: EcoControl active hai magar Master outlet theek se assign nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: The device connected to the Master outlet uses too little current to be detected as off.
causes.ur: Master outlet se jude device ka current itna kam hai ke off detect nahi hota.

solutions.en: Activate or set properly the EcoControl function using the software provided with the product (Eaton UPS Companion over USB).
solutions.ur: Product ke saath diye gaye software (USB par Eaton UPS Companion) se EcoControl function activate ya theek set karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the Master outlet assignment in the configuration software matches the outlet your computer is on.
solutions.ur: Configuration software mein Master outlet ki assignment check karein ke woh us outlet se match karti hai jahan computer laga hai.

solutions.en: Do not put a mains adapter with near-zero load on the Master outlet; use a device that draws measurable current.
solutions.ur: Master outlet par aisa mains adapter na lagayein jis ka load qarebi zero ho; aisa device lagayein jo measurable current le.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)
